title: Shipping Policy
intro: Every blend is ground after you order, so dispatch takes a little longer than a warehouse — and arrives far fresher.

sections.heading: Shipping charges
sections.body:
Shipping is free on orders of ₹399 and above.

Below ₹399, shipping is ₹50 within Karnataka and ₹70 for the rest of India.

sections.heading: Dispatch and delivery
sections.body: Your order is handcrafted and dispatched within 48 hours. Delivery usually takes 3–5 days after dispatch, depending on your location.

sections.heading: Where we deliver
sections.body: We ship across India. Delivery times to remote PIN codes may be slightly longer.

sections.heading: Tracking your order
sections.body: You will receive tracking details on WhatsApp as soon as your order is dispatched.

faq.question: What are the shipping charges for KokoFresh orders?
faq.answer: Shipping is ₹50 for orders within Karnataka and ₹70 for the rest of India. Orders of ₹399 and above ship free.

faq.question: Does KokoFresh offer free shipping?
faq.answer: Yes. Shipping is free on all orders of ₹399 and above at checkout.

faq.question: What are KokoFresh delivery timelines?
faq.answer: Orders are ground fresh and dispatched within 48 hours, then delivered in 3–5 days depending on your location.
